units.source_text: 不久天色向晓。

en.t: Before long, the sky began to brighten toward dawn.

units.source_text: 匂亲王开了边门，携二女公子同往窗前观赏晓色。

en.t: Prince Niou opened the side door and took the Second Princess with him to the window to admire the dawn.

units.source_text: 但见朝雾弥漫，添得许多奇景。

en.t: Morning mist lay everywhere, adding many strange and beautiful sights.

units.source_text: 那些载柴的船，隐隐约约地在雾中行驶，后面泛着白浪。

en.t: Boats loaded with firewood moved faintly through the mist, leaving white waves behind them.

units.source_text: 真是难得见到的住处啊！

en.t: What a rare dwelling this was to behold.

units.source_text: 富有情趣的匂亲王心中颇感兴味。

en.t: Prince Niou, who had a keen sense of beauty, found it deeply engaging.

units.source_text: 山端渐渐射出阳光，照见二女公子容颜美丽无比。

en.t: Sunlight gradually streamed from the edge of the mountains and revealed the Second Princess's incomparable beauty.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想：“至高至贵的金枝玉叶，恐怕也不过这般模样吧。

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "Even ladies of the highest and noblest birth could hardly look finer than this.

units.source_text: 我因偏袒胞妹，认为大公主天下无双，其实非也。”

en.t: Because I favored my own younger sister, I thought the Elder Princess was unmatched in the world, but I was mistaken."

units.source_text: 他希望更仔细、更恣意地欣赏她的美貌，这匆匆一面，反而使他感到不满足了。

en.t: He longed to gaze on her beauty more closely and at leisure, and this hurried glimpse only left him dissatisfied.

units.source_text: 水声时刻不停，宇治桥古色苍然，遥遥在望。

en.t: The sound of the water never ceased, and the old, weathered Uji Bridge could be seen far in the distance.

units.source_text: 朝雾逐渐消散，两岸景色更加显得荒凉满目。

en.t: As the morning mist gradually cleared, the scenery on both banks looked still more desolate.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“这种地方，如何可以长年久居！”

en.t: Prince Niou said, "How could anyone live for years in such a place?"

units.source_text: 说罢流下泪来。

en.t: With that, he began to shed tears.

units.source_text: 二女公子听了颇觉羞耻。

en.t: Hearing this, the Second Princess felt deeply embarrassed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王生得相貌堂堂，俊秀无比。

en.t: Prince Niou was naturally dignified in appearance and surpassingly handsome.

units.source_text: 他信誓旦旦，表示愿生生世世为夫妇。

en.t: He swore solemnly that he wished them to be husband and wife through every lifetime.

units.source_text: 二女公子意想不到结得这般良缘，觉得这丈夫比以前见惯的严肃的薰中纳言更为可亲。

en.t: The Second Princess had never expected to form such a fortunate bond, and she felt this husband was more approachable than the stern Kaoru Chujo, whom she had long been used to seeing.

units.source_text: 她仔细寻思：“薰中纳言性情乖异，态度严肃，令人一见自感羞惭，不敢接近。

en.t: She reflected carefully, "Kaoru Chujo has an eccentric nature and a severe manner, making one feel ashamed at first sight and afraid to draw near.

units.source_text: 而这位匂亲王呢，据传闻推测，比薰中纳言更加不可亲近。

en.t: As for Prince Niou, judging from the rumors, I had thought he would be even harder to approach than Kaoru Chujo.

units.source_text: 因此当时对于他的一封简单的来信，也犹豫不敢作复。

en.t: For that reason, even when he sent a simple letter, I hesitated and did not dare reply.

units.source_text: 岂知一经相识，便觉今后如果久不相见，何等寂寞无聊。

en.t: Yet once I came to know him, I felt how lonely and dreary it would be if we did not meet for a long time hereafter.

units.source_text: 此种感想，使我自己亦觉奇怪。”

en.t: Even I find such feelings strange."

units.source_text: 匂亲王的随从人等频频扬声咳嗽，催促返驾。

en.t: Prince Niou's attendants repeatedly coughed loudly, urging him to return.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也希望趁早返京，免得受人注目。

en.t: Prince Niou also wished to return to the capital early, lest he attract attention.

units.source_text: 他心绪缭乱，向二女公子反复声言：今后难免有遭逢意外阻碍而不能相聚之夜。

en.t: With his heart in turmoil, he told the Second Princess again and again that in the future there would inevitably be nights when unexpected obstacles kept them from meeting.

units.source_text: 临别赠诗云：

en.t: At parting, he offered this poem:
